• SSO IDM Production L2 Engineer
  • Location: Singapore
  • Contract Duration: 12 months, extendable
  • Experience: 8+ years of relevant experience

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced SSO IDM Production L2 Engineer to support and maintain Single Sign-On (SSO) and Identity Management (IDM) platforms within a production security environment. The role focuses on platform availability, incident and problem management, troubleshooting, and controlled production changes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and maintain the availability, performance, and capacity of SSO and IDM production platforms.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents, working closely with development and infrastructure teams.
  • Manage problem investigations, root cause analysis, and service improvement initiatives.
  • Plan and execute production changes and deployments in accordance with established change management procedures.
  • Support authentication, authorisation, access provisioning, and security-related configurations.
  • Identify operational risks and ensure timely escalation and adherence to security and compliance standards.
  • Participate in on-call and out-of-hours support when required.

Key Requirements

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in production support, IT security, IAM, or SSO environments.
  • Hands-on experience with CA SiteMinder Web SSO and identity provisioning tools such as BMC Control-SA, SailPoint, or ForgeRock.
  • Strong knowledge of LDAP, SAML, Kerberos, SSL/TLS, PKI, and authentication protocols.
  • Experience supporting web technologies such as Apache, Tomcat, Nginx, or IIS.
  • Scripting or automation experience using Python, shell, or Ansible.
  • Strong incident management, troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to participate in on-call and out-of-hours production support.

Desirable: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, API security, Apigee, SQL, and ITIL knowledge.

job.title: IAM Solutions Architect (Global End user environment)
job.description:
We are partnering with a global organisation to appoint an Identity & Access Management (IAM) Solution Architect who will play a key role in shaping and delivering its enterprise identity architecture.

This is a hands-on architecture position covering the full IAM landscape —

You will work across security, infrastructure, cloud, applications and operational technology teams to translate business and security requirements into scalable IAM solutions.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own and evolve IAM solution architecture, reference designs and reusable architectural patterns.
  • Design solutions across IGA, PAM, SSO, federation, MFA, Conditional Access, directory services and non-human identities.
  • Architect PAM capabilities
  • Design authentication and access solutions using Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, including SSO, MFA, passwordless authentication, Conditional Access and B2B access.
  • Design integrations across cloud, SaaS, on-premise and OT platforms using technologies including SAML, OIDC, OAuth, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos, APIs and X.509.
  • Provide architecture oversight throughout the delivery lifecycle, from requirements and solution design through implementation, testing and transition into operations.
  • Work closely with engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, application and vendor teams to ensure solutions align with security and enterprise architecture standards.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4–6 years' experience in IAM solution architecting
  • Proven experience designing and delivering complex enterprise IAM solutions.
  • Strong knowledge across IGA, PAM, Access Management, Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory.
  • Strong understanding of identity standards and protocols including SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, LDAP and Kerberos.
  • Comfortable working across multiple technical domains and communicating architecture decisions to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.

job.title: Network Engineer (MNC)
job.description:
Network Engineer

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Network Engineer to support enterprise network infrastructure, covering network design, project implementation, operational support and security. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining reliable, secure and high-performing network services across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

Network Infrastructure & Project Delivery

  • Plan and deliver network infrastructure initiatives, including office expansions, infrastructure upgrades, network migrations and wireless improvements.

  • Gather technical requirements and develop implementation plans, testing procedures and contingency arrangements.

  • Perform hands-on network configuration, deployment, migration and implementation activities.

  • Design, maintain and improve network infrastructure across enterprise connectivity, wireless networks, remote access and cloud environments.

  • Prepare and maintain network designs, architecture documentation, addressing plans and configuration standards.

  • Work closely with internal technology teams to deliver network solutions that support business and application requirements.

  • Identify opportunities to improve network availability, performance, scalability and resilience.

  • Coordinate infrastructure upgrades, security patching, configuration reviews and recovery testing.

  • Explore automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency and configuration consistency.

Network Operations & Support

  • Provide advanced technical support for network incidents, service requests and escalations.

  • Monitor network performance, availability and capacity, investigating potential issues and implementing corrective measures.

  • Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures to minimise recurring incidents.

  • Coordinate network changes in line with established operational procedures.

  • Participate in on-call support and scheduled maintenance outside standard working hours when required.

  • Maintain network service availability and performance in accordance with agreed operational targets.

Network Security & Risk Management

  • Implement and maintain network access controls, firewall policies, secure connectivity and network segmentation.

  • Ensure network infrastructure adheres to security standards, configuration baselines and patching requirements.

  • Identify security weaknesses and coordinate remediation activities.

  • Support security assessments, compliance reviews and audit-related activities.

  • Follow established IT governance, operational and information security policies.

Vendor Management & Documentation

  • Support technical evaluations, requirements gathering, procurement exercises and vendor selection.

  • Coordinate external service providers throughout implementation and ongoing support activities.

  • Monitor service quality against contractual commitments and manage maintenance arrangements, renewals and infrastructure lifecycle requirements.

  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, network diagrams, asset records and operational procedures.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related discipline.

  • At least 6 years of relevant experience in network engineering or enterprise network infrastructure.

  • Experience supporting multi-site network environments and delivering infrastructure projects from planning through implementation.

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate third-party providers and ensure delivery against agreed requirements.

Technical Competencies

  • Strong understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including IP networking, routing, switching, network addressing, DNS, DHCP, VPN and traffic management.

  • Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure and security appliances.

  • Experience managing firewall policies, secure remote access, network segmentation and high-availability configurations.

  • Knowledge of enterprise wireless infrastructure, deployment planning and performance optimisation.

  • Familiarity with network monitoring, diagnostics and performance management tools.

  • Understanding of network security principles, vulnerability remediation and infrastructure hardening.

  • Working knowledge of public cloud networking and connectivity between on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Exposure to access control technologies, modern network security architectures and secure connectivity solutions.

Certifications

  • Relevant professional networking certifications are preferred.

  • Vendor-specific networking or security certifications would be advantageous.

Personal Attributes

  • Independent and proactive, with strong ownership of technical responsibilities.

  • Analytical and methodical in troubleshooting complex technical issues.

  • Effective communicator with the ability to engage internal stakeholders and external service providers.

  • Able to manage competing project and operational priorities.

  • Willing to learn and adapt to evolving infrastructure and security technologies.
